LANDING CAUTION — THE OPEN GERRIT CHANGES ARE NOT ALL THIS EPIC'S STACK. Recording before the landing step, because "land the stack" read naively would submit other people's work.

There are now 21 open changes owned by RebarBotNava, 19 submittable. At least THREE are NOT epic 061c:
  1166  5200: prove the outbound half over a real store copy   (LLM +1, Ver +1, but NOT submittable)
  1167  e161: fix SIGPIPE-fragile push retry classifier        (both votes pending)
  1162  5200: wait out index lag before the inbound pass
These come from ANOTHER concurrent session — I observed a second `rebar review-plan` process running from a different worktree (/Users/joeoakhart/impl-42eb-tickets-clone, ticket 42eb) on this same machine. That session shares the Gerrit remote and the RebarBotNava identity.

CONSEQUENCE: when epic 061c closes, submit ONLY the changes whose `rebar-ticket:` trailer names one of THIS epic's tickets. Do not submit by "everything owner:self and submittable". Derive the list from the epic's closed ticket ids and match each change's trailer — `git log --grep="rebar-ticket: <id>"` per ticket, or read each change's commit message. Note also that 1166 carries both +1s yet is NOT submittable, which is a reminder that the third submit condition (no unresolved comments) is real and invisible to a votes-only check.

Not my work and not to be touched — but also not to be swept into this epic's landing.
